title: Sovereign Capability Intelligence Index with Uncertainty and Risk Modeling
overview: A deterministic, composite sovereign capability intelligence index integrating artificial intelligence capacity, governance quality, post-quantum cybersecurity readiness, and systemic resilience. The framework incorporates explicit uncertainty adjustment, confidence-weighted ranking, and risk signaling for decision-grade analysis.

methodology.determinism: no stochastic processes; fully reproducible pipeline

score_scale.interpretation: Higher values indicate stronger sovereign capability across AI, governance, cybersecurity readiness, and systemic resilience

decision_framework.high_capability_high_confidence: Reliable strategic powers with strong institutional, technological, and systemic foundations
decision_framework.high_capability_low_confidence: Modeled or uncertain powers; outcomes sensitive to missing or imputed data
decision_framework.mid_capability_high_confidence: Stable emerging systems with consistent structural capacity

rank_gap_interpretation.positive: Confidence penalty; raw capability likely overestimated

derived_metrics.risk_flag_definition: Entities with high capability (>0.7) but low confidence (<0.6), indicating potential instability, model sensitivity, or data sparsity

analytical_notes.statistical_note: Median imputation introduces central tendency bias, reducing variance and potentially inflating mid-tier rankings
analytical_notes.comparability_note: Indicators are normalized for cross-country comparison; underlying source methodologies may differ

classification.methodological_class: Composite Index with Explicit Uncertainty Adjustment
classification.audit_level: Independent reproducible computational audit with cryptographic integrity chaining

reproducibility.reproducibility_note: All outputs are fully reproducible given identical input datasets and execution conditions
